acceptanceCriteria: A docs task leaves planning without declared tests or red proof and leaves validation without green proof
A feature task still owes declared tests, red proof and green proof
diagnosis: Reproduced: a docs task with spec, files.allow and acceptance criteria but no tests or proofs fails task phase next in planning with CDX-E604 'declared tests, red proof'. Root cause: missingPlanningEvidence in workflow/phases.ts demands declared tests and red proof for every task.type, and missingExitEvidence demands a green proof at validation for every type, while SPEC 4.12.2 change classes say docs skips the red and green proofs. Only the docs class is in scope here; refactor/deps/chore class paths are unchanged.

failing: [§4.12.2] docs class skips the red and green proofs while feature still owes them
